versions.changelog: Swarm bus default is now local rather than a shared host.

Swarm bus default is now local. The skill previously documented a specific shared NATS host as the default for KANNAKA_NATS_URL and in config.toml, which pointed installers at infrastructure they do not control; it now defaults to your own NATS and explains what joining a shared bus means.
Add ADR-0035 swarm sensemaking commands (brief --peers, health --apply)
